import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-navbar', templateUrl: './navbar.component.html', styleUrls: ['./navbar.component.css'], }) export class NavbarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy { isLoggedIn = false; username = ''; cartCount = 0; private storageListener: any; constructor(private router: Router) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.checkLoginStatus(); this.loadCartCount(); // Listen for storage changes (for logout from other tabs) this.storageListener = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === 'logout' || event.key === 'username') { this.checkLoginStatus(); this.loadCartCount(); } }; window.addEventListener('storage', this.storageListener); } ngOnDestroy(): void { if (this.storageListener) { window.removeEventListener('storage', this.storageListener); } } checkLoginStatus(): void { const user = localStorage.getItem('username'); this.isLoggedIn = !!user && user !== 'null' && user !== 'undefined'; this.username = user || ''; } loadCartCount(): void { const cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart') || '[]'); this.cartCount = cart.length; } logout(): void { if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) { // Clear all user data from localStorage localStorage.clear(); // Set logout flag for other tabs localStorage.setItem('logout', Date.now().toString()); // Reset state this.isLoggedIn = false; this.username = ''; this.cartCount = 0; // Show success message alert('Logged out successfully! 👋'); // Navigate to home page this.router.navigate(['/home']); } } }
